title: Nonnegativity of the spectral parameter
statement: Let $n\ge 2$ and let $A$ be a real $n\times n$ matrix. Define $\lambda(A)$ as the supremum of $\|Av\|$ over unit vectors $v$ orthogonal to the constant vector whose entries are $1/n$. Then $\lambda(A)\ge 0$.
